items.title: Right question for a bearish market: Not ‘will it fall’, but ‘is the business falling’? 5 large-caps with upside potential of up to 29%
items.description: The best large companies are the ones FPIs own the most. So, when they decide to sell, it is precisely these high-quality stocks that see the heaviest selling. That is one of the reasons why large-cap stocks have been under pressure of late.
